headline.text: L3 ML1 battled *low temper* for 2.5 hours before recovering; L3 ML4 recurring jams and depositor overflows slowed throughput

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran all four Sollich lines. Sol1 recovered from chiller/compressor shutdown early morning. Sol3 stopped at 12:24 for belt fraying on Cross Conveyor 3—maintenance removing fibers and cleaning. Sol4 held 27 boxes for color evaluation and reported piece weight running thin.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ran ML2 and ML3 with minimal breaks. ML3 cleared two label-break stoppages on second shift. Sol2 accumulated jars waiting on boxes mid-shift; boxes arrived and packing resumed.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML1 struggled with low temper from 03:45 to 06:19—adjusted crystallization twice, eventually started. ML4 saw recurring overhead conveyor jams and depositor 1 overflows; max fill limit lowered to 70%. Truffle line reheated buffer tank and started at 06:09.

notes.text: Third-shift operator brought floor drain covers from ML1 to south wash room for cleaning; redirected to clean in place.
Shawn and Rich troubleshot ML4 spiral conveyor metering; identified sensor out of position and coached operators on caddie spacing requirements.

resolved.title: Sol1 chiller shut off, lost start temp
resolved.summary: Chiller and pump shut down completely at 05:04; went to reheat to regain start temp.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:26 — "We are at starting temp in program and tempering the chocolate" (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: Sol3 line paused to pass accumulation
resolved.summary: Multiple pauses (15:48, 17:55, 18:30) to clear packer backlog; resumed each time.
resolved.resolution: Last pause cleared at 18:30 — "Line is running again" (William Beattie).

resolved.title: Sol3 macadamia residual by Sol2
resolved.summary: Macadamia pieces found near Sol2; needed immediate removal for allergen control.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 18:00 — William Beattie swept up and posted photo.

resolved.title: Sol4 packer rails in wrong position
resolved.summary: Rails handed off open; operators found and corrected position at shift start.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:35 — operators fixed and posted photo (S4 Pack Tablet).

resolved.title: ML3 label breaking on packer
resolved.summary: Label broke at top when switching rolls; line stopped at 14:31 for reinstall.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:36 — "Line is running again, we reinstalled the label and do a small lubrication on the rollers" (Molding Line 3 Pack). Broke again at 14:55, cleared at 14:57.

resolved.title: ML3 rejections from stuck chocolate on vacuum
resolved.summary: Chocolate piece lodged in vacuum caused moving pieces to be rejected; stopped 6 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:43 — removed stuck piece, "running good again" (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 4 mold jam—screws loose
resolved.summary: Two screws came loose from nozzle plate at 13:40, jamming molds; maintenance removed molds and tightened bolts.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:05 — "Removed both molds with no damage, tightened up the plate bolts and replaced the bent one" (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: ML4 cold stamp door sensor failed
resolved.summary: Machine detected door open when all doors closed; sensor failure stopped line at 16:40.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 18:08 — "Sensor was just replaced on this door" (Chad Stone); line restarted.

resolved.title: Truffle line kitchen buffer temp drop
resolved.summary: Buffer chocolate temp dropped at 05:25; put on reheat, tempering process delayed line start.

resolved.title: ML1 inclusion hopper not suctioning rice
resolved.summary: Hopper failed to pull rice during Crunch changeover startup; suspected flap inside blocking vacuum.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:51 — maintenance lowered hopper, addressed flap, line resumed (Rose Smuin).

resolved.title: ML1 belt C6 shifted and triggered alarm
resolved.summary: Belt tracking alarm at flow-wrap; maintenance adjusted and centered the belt.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:02 — "C6 belt is centered and running well at this time" (Molding Line 1 Flow-Wrap).

resolved.title: Truffle enrober tank frozen causing bad coverage
resolved.summary: Chocolate tank froze; coverage out of spec at 08:10; operator cleaned tank.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:12 — "Now it's looks better. Thank you Grey Boscan" (Mirella Mamani); exit temp at 26.0°C.

needs_attention.title: Sol3 belt fraying on cross conveyor 3
needs_attention.summary: Cross Conveyor 3 belt fraying along edge at 12:24; line shut down to remove fibers and inspect product for contamination.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance removing fibers with heat; equipment will be cleaned with soap/water and ATP tested before restart. QA inspecting hopper and return conveyor product. Charity noted small frays on return belts will be addressed after inspection complete.

needs_attention.title: Sol4 chiller compressor 1 low refrigerant
needs_attention.summary: Compressor 1 refrigerant low; tech scheduled for 10:00–10:30 fill, arrived at 12:31 and filling R-134A.
needs_attention.status: Tech filling compressor 1 with refrigerant as of 12:31. Curt asked if correct refrigerant; Chris confirmed R-134A in use.

needs_attention.title: Sol3 caramel cook time slow on C2
needs_attention.summary: C2 cooking at ~72 minutes, C1 at ~32 minutes; line may need to pause for caramel before end of second shift.
needs_attention.status: C2 caustic cleaned at 21:46; line ran at reduced speed through shift end. Cook times remain elevated.

needs_attention.title: Sol4 27 boxes WIP held for color evaluation
needs_attention.summary: Third-shift candy (item 21167) has darker appearance than normal; flavor and smoothness acceptable but color appears out of spec.
needs_attention.status: 27 boxes on hold awaiting QA evaluation of color tone. Katya, Justin, and Charity tagged.

needs_attention.title: Sol4 piece weight inconsistencies—thinner during cutting
needs_attention.summary: Pieces coming out thinner, causing weight variations near lower acceptable limit; dimensions in range but weight drifting.
needs_attention.status: Still in spec as of 11:58; Justin acknowledged and said team will work on fixing. Pieces remain acceptable but trending low.

needs_attention.title: Sol2 jars accumulated awaiting boxes
needs_attention.summary: Two pallets of jars accumulated because boxes were unavailable; boxes arrived at 12:20 and packing resumed.
needs_attention.status: Boxes arrived, working on packing all jars as of 12:20. Justin, Curt, and Katya tagged.

needs_attention.title: ML4 overhead conveyor jams recurring
needs_attention.summary: Five separate jam stoppages on overhead spiral conveyor between 22:24 and 04:43; Shawn and Rich identified sensor and caddie spacing issues.
needs_attention.status: Sensor adjusted at 08:47; operators coached on maintaining full caddie-length gaps. Jams continued through third shift (01:02, 01:58, 02:15, 04:38).

needs_attention.title: ML1 temper low for 2.5 hours, multiple adjustments
needs_attention.summary: Temper readings stuck at -0.9 to -1.0 from 03:45 through 06:10 despite two crystallization adjustments; line could not start until temper reached -0.4.
needs_attention.status: Line started at 06:19 after crystallization raised to 79.2, but further adjustments needed through morning (decreased to 79.1 at 07:00, then 78.0 at 11:46).

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG4 layflat caddie printing issues
needs_attention.summary: Lot code change at 00:21 revealed persistent print quality problems; videojet swapped at 09:06 but print still inconsistent.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance swapped videojet and replaced printhead module; roller has ink buildup causing smearing. Printing better but operators watching for accumulation as of 05:49.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 1 overflows recurring
needs_attention.summary: Depositor 1 overflowed three times (03:51, 04:54, 06:34) due to mixing auger continuing when stopped; sensors cleaned.
needs_attention.status: Max fill limit lowered to 70% at 06:59 as workaround. Shawn notes mixing auger runs even without new chocolate/cookies added, causing overfill during downtime.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line sensor B142 broken
needs_attention.summary: Sensor B142 at flow-wrap not working; maintenance confirms broken and needs replacement.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance contacted; sensor confirmed broken and requires replacement. No immediate impact on operation noted.
